Randomized accdb transaction and record operation tests with invariant checks.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_accdb` administration and user interfaces on top of `funk` storage. It creates an anonymous workspace, builds a `fd_funk` instance, and then runs a long sequence of random operations that attach child transactions, insert records, and advance the root. The test compares each operation against a reference model from `test_funk_common.c` and uses `fd_accdb_verify` to check transaction tree rules, record map rules, and record replacement behavior during root advancement.

The file also contains helper code that resets all unallocated `fd_funk` records and transactions to known values, then checks that the database is empty after cleanup. The [`verify_recs_empty`](<#verify_recs_empty>), [`verify_txns_empty`](<#verify_txns_empty>), and [`verify_accdb_empty`](<#verify_accdb_empty>) functions confirm that hash chains are empty, object pool elements are returned and initialized, and no allocator state remains in use. The [`main`](<#main>) function parses command-line options for workspace and test sizes, creates the random number generator and workspace, runs the test, and then releases all resources before reporting `pass`.
